description: This file is a TypeScript script that performs static analysis on other source files in a project. It imports TypeScript compiler APIs and project-specific utility functions to scan source files for specific code patterns related to pairing store identifiers in group authorization logic. The script checks for references to certain store-related variables and functions, and reports violations if found.

methods.name: getDeclarationNameText
methods.description: Extracts the text from a declaration name, whether an identifier or binding pattern.

methods.name: containsPairingStoreSource
methods.description: Recursively checks if a node contains references to pairing store identifiers or specific store-related call expressions.

methods.name: getCallName
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a call expression node.

methods.name: isSuspiciousNormalizeWithStoreCall
methods.description: Detects calls to 'normalizeAllowFromWithStore' with specific property conditions indicating pairing-store entries.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Analyzes a TypeScript source file content and finds violations where pairing-store identifiers are referenced improperly in group auth code.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that runs the analysis over project files, reports violations, or exits if issues are found.
